Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs.

Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions.

Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth.
